claims.claim: The victory of the Christian faith in the ancient world likely owed much to a reversal that promised immortality to those whose world was doomed.
claims.supporting_excerpt: Historically, it is more than probable that the victory of the Christian faith in the ancient world was largely due to this reversal, which brought hope to those who knew that their world was doomed, indeed a hope beyond hope, since the new message promised an immortality they never had dared to hope for.

claims.claim: The rise of Christian individual immortality as the central creed of Western mankind resulted in life on earth becoming man's highest good.
claims.supporting_excerpt: This may be the reason for the undisputable fact that only when the immortality of individual life became the central creed of Western mankind, that is, only with the rise of Christianity, did life on earth also become the highest good of man.

must_not_be_lost: Christianity's focus on individual immortality caused political activity to sink to an activity subject to necessity.
Earthly life became the highest good of man only when individual immortality became the central creed of Western mankind.
output.segment_function: Historical analysis of how the Christian faith's promise of individual immortality transformed the status of politics, the body politic, and the ultimate value of earthly life.
